page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Right margin with partly cut-off marginal notes (fragments only). Printed page number and running head at the top. Signature "G 5" at the foot.

main_text.p: rent, quasi id argueret animum de republicâ securum, ac rerum privatarum tantummodò studiosum[?]. Leges suas tabulis ligneis inscriptas propofuit in publico, quas tabulas Ἄξονας vocavit aut κύρβεις[?]. Obligavit Athenienses ad eas servandas in annos centum, adegitque senatum in eas jurare, & post senatum singulos archontes, additâ poenâ, ut recedens ab iis Apollini Delphico statuam auream pondere sibi parem poneret. Denique legumlatione absolutâ anni Attici rationes ad motum Solis redegit. Et hæ leges Solonis cum totâ reipublicæ constitutione tam[illegible, ~2 letters] venerabiles populo fuêre, ut ne tyrannus quidem Pisistratus, Soloni sanguine[illegible, ~1 letter] junctus, quanquâm potestatem legibus[illegible, ~3 letters] majorem usurparet, eas abolere in animum induxerit, nec filii ejus ab ejusdem morte. Primi verò cccc-viri[?] anno belli Peloponnesiaci xxi,abdicato statu populari eas abrogarunt, sed intra vertentem annum dominatu suo dejecti rursus locum iis dare necessum habuerunt. Iterumque post septennium,cum fine belli Peloponnesiaci, à xxx tyrannis vulgò sic vocatis leges hæ abolitæ[illegible, ~2 letters] & iisdem post pauculos annos everfis[illegible, ~3 letters] denuò in usum sunt revocatæ, vigorem[illegible, ~2 letters]remque suum per multa sæcula secuta

page.notes: The right margin carries only cut-off fragments of marginal notes (about a dozen small glyph groups at the page edge, e.g. beside "tam", "tyran-", "junctus", "everfis", "vigorem", and near the foot); they are unreadable and transcribed as illegible placeholders with approximate letter counts. A red stamp and a red edge mark on the right margin are not printed text and are omitted. Left-margin marks are edge or show-through and are omitted. No catchword is visible at the foot. "legumlatione" is printed as shown (probably for legislatione). "xxi,abdicato" and "cccc-viri" are read from a damaged print; the "[?]" marks show doubt. The bottom-right "reuri 29es" fragment is a margin or show-through fragment and is not transcribed as text. The Greek "κύρβεις" is doubtful and is marked [?].
